provenance: Synthetic preparation examples authored for evaluation; not LLM output or completed human review.
purpose: 20 labeled texts for sensitive-detail evaluation (AC-18); confirm exact criterion and thresholds with the pod.

texts.text: Investigators isolated the affected server at 192.0.2.14.
texts.rationale: An exact endpoint address is an infrastructure detail.

texts.text: The affected application runs on payroll.internal.example.
texts.rationale: The internal hostname identifies a specific system.

texts.text: The investigation identified CVE-2025-12345 on the affected gateway.
texts.rationale: A vulnerability identifier can reveal a specific attack opportunity; this identifier is synthetic.

texts.text: An unpatched server remains isolated while remediation is scheduled.
texts.rationale: The text discloses an unresolved weakness.

texts.text: The firewall rule allowed inbound access to the administrative service.
texts.rationale: The configuration detail reveals an access-control condition.

texts.text: The monitored endpoint used IPv6 address 2001:db8::25.
texts.rationale: An exact IPv6 endpoint is an infrastructure detail.

texts.text: A connection from 198.51.100.7 reached archive.internal.example.
texts.rationale: Both endpoint identifiers require separate flags.

texts.text: The unpatched device at 203.0.113.18 was removed from service.
texts.rationale: Both the unresolved weakness and the endpoint address are sensitive.

texts.text: Investigators removed firewall rules and isolated reports.internal.example.
texts.rationale: The access-control reference and internal hostname are distinct details.

texts.text: CVE-2024-54321 was recorded on an unpatched system.
texts.rationale: The synthetic vulnerability identifier and unpatched status both disclose weaknesses.

texts.text: The company temporarily suspended access to an affected service.
texts.rationale: A general operational description identifies no endpoint or exploitable configuration.

texts.text: The investigation began at 08:15 UTC on October 1, 2026.
texts.rationale: A discovery timestamp alone is not a technical attack detail.

texts.text: Approximately 120 employees experienced a two-hour interruption.
texts.rationale: The statement describes scale and duration without infrastructure identifiers.

texts.text: The financial impact remains under investigation.
texts.rationale: Uncertainty about impact does not disclose a technical weakness.

texts.text: Not yet determined
texts.rationale: The required missing-information placeholder carries no sensitive detail.

texts.text: Investigators reviewed README.txt and payroll.xlsx during the assessment.
texts.rationale: These generic filenames are not hostnames; checks false positives from dotted text.

texts.text: The incident affected application version 2.4.1; no vulnerability was identified in the available evidence.
texts.rationale: An unnamed application's version is not an IP address or a disclosed exploitable weakness.

texts.text: The response team restored service and continued monitoring.
texts.rationale: A general recovery statement contains no concrete attack detail.

texts.text: A customer support ticket documented intermittent login failures.
texts.rationale: A symptom without credentials, endpoints or configuration details is not sensitive under this rubric.

texts.text: The affected business unit notified its internal response team.
texts.rationale: A general organizational response contains no technical attack information.
